exposure: Legal standing of healthcare institutions (public vs. private)
cohort: Births recorded in the Colombian National Statistics Administrative Department (DANE) database.
finding: After a period of sustained growth in cesarean section rates in Colombia, there has been a recent reduction; however, cesarean section rates remain consistently higher in private healthcare institutions compared to public institutions.
mod_finding: The study examines the frequency of cesarean sections in Colombia, finding a reduction in the overall proportion but a higher frequency in private healthcare providers.
